UC-1150.note: New. Heading of the permissions step at the head of the first screen (issue 5), between the lede and Open the folder; shows only when macOS or Windows needs something answered before the first matter

UC-1151.en: Answer here first, so macOS doesn't stop you in the middle of a matter.
UC-1151.note: New. The step's lead on the Mac, under its heading

UC-1153.en: Your keychain / Clauseo keeps your sign-ins and connector passwords in your Mac's keychain. macOS asks once for each and wants your Mac's login password. Choose Always Allow. Plain Allow means macOS asks again next time.
UC-1153.note: New. The Mac's second row, the keychain, when a read of Clauseo's own items would prompt: name, then reason, with stage E's line on Always Allow and the login password

UC-1154.note: New. A row's button; macOS's own dialog opens only after it is pressed. Only the first row not asked yet has it

UC-1155.en: macOS is asking. Choose Allow in its window.
UC-1155.note: New. The Documents row while macOS's dialog waits for the lawyer's answer

UC-1156.en: macOS is asking. Type your Mac's login password, then choose Always Allow.
UC-1156.note: New. The keychain row while macOS's dialog waits for the lawyer's answer

UC-1157.note: New. A row macOS has allowed, with a tick; never asked again

UC-1158.en: Not allowed. / You can allow it in {path}.
UC-1158.note: New. The Documents row refused; {path} is the desktop's settings_path, shown as given (System Settings › Privacy & Security › Files and Folders › Clauseo)

UC-1159.note: New. Under the refused Documents row: opens System Settings at Files and Folders

UC-1160.en: You can allow it here at any time.
UC-1160.note: Changed (#1303 review). The refused keychain row, after "Not allowed."; its Allow stays. Was "macOS asks again the next time Clauseo opens. Choose Always Allow then."

UC-1161.en: Clauseo couldn't ask macOS. Try again.
UC-1161.note: New. A row whose ask failed (the desktop couldn't ask); its Allow stays

UC-1162.en: Windows is blocking your matters folder / Windows blocks the assistants' tools, such as PowerShell, from saving in protected folders. Choose a matters folder outside Documents, Desktop and Pictures, or ask your IT team.
UC-1162.note: New. Windows, Controlled folder access over the matters folder: the row's name (app track's), then its text, stage E's words from the Windows run (the block falls on the assistants' tools, such as PowerShell, not on Clauseo). Nothing is asked on Windows. Its words sit in one place (permissions.tsx's WINDOWS)

UC-1163.en: Windows may be blocking your matters folder
UC-1163.note: New. Windows, Controlled folder access that a standard account can't read: the row's name; its text is UC-1162's second line

UC-1164.note: New. The open matter's line (Windows, Controlled folder access over its folder): Locate folder's flow (the picker, then relocate_matter) for the folder the lawyer moved out of Documents

UC-1165.en: Choose a matters folder outside Documents
UC-1165.note: New. The Windows row's action (its advice); the desktop's settings_path and note show under it as given. Today it opens the first screen's Open the folder picker, so the folder chosen opens as the first matter; it does not yet change where Start a new matter makes matters

UC-1166.note: New. Under a refused Documents row or the Windows row: reads the rows again after the lawyer changed the setting

UC-1167.en: Windows' Controlled folder access blocks saving in this folder
UC-1167.note: New, the orchestrator's words. Heading of the open matter's standing line on Windows when Controlled folder access protects its folder; stage E's sentence (UC-1162) follows

UC-1168.en: Move this matter's folder out of {folder} in File Explorer, then choose it here.
UC-1168.note: Changed (#1303 review). The open matter's line, after stage E's sentence; {folder} is the protected folder the matter is in (Documents, Desktop or Pictures). Was "…out of Documents in File Explorer…". Nothing in Clauseo moves files today

UC-1169.en: New matters now go in {folder}. Matters you already have stay where they are. / Your firm sets where new matters go, so it can't be changed here. / Clauseo couldn't use that folder. Choose it again. / Clauseo couldn't save the change. Try again.
